title: Good Night Stories for Rebel Girls: 100 Tales of Extraordinary Women
author: Elena Favilli and Francesca Cavallo
target_audience: Parents, caregivers, and educators seeking empowering reading material
Anyone interested in women’s history and role models
primary_purpose: To inspire and empower children—especially girls—through captivating, accessible stories that showcase the lives and achievements of real women from diverse backgrounds, illustrating a multitude of possibilities for future generations.

structure_format.narrative_style: Story-based, engaging, and lyrical; each biography is written in a fairytale-like tone
structure_format.organization: 100 one-page stories, each dedicated to a single woman, paired with a full-page illustrated portrait
features: Colorful, commissioned illustrations from female artists worldwide
Globally representative selection of women from different eras, fields, and cultures
Short, self-contained stories suitable for bedtime reading

key_concepts_lessons: Girls and women are capable of extraordinary achievements in every field.
One's dreams and aspirations should not be limited by gender or societal expectations.
Courage, curiosity, and perseverance are shared traits among trailblazers.
The world is enriched by contributions from women of all backgrounds, cultures, and disciplines.
Representation and role models are critical for inspiring the next generation.
notable_features: 100 stories about real women from around the world
Inclusive of a diverse range of disciplines, historical periods, and cultures
Written in a bedtime story format to encourage nightly conversations about ambition and equality
Sparked a global movement and inspired sequels and adaptations
cultural_historical_context: Published in 2016 amid renewed global advocacy for gender equality and representation, the book addressed a gap in children’s literature by centering women’s stories. It became a symbol of the modern feminist movement, encouraging young readers to dream ambitiously.
reception_impact: International bestseller; translated into dozens of languages
Widely celebrated by educators, parents, and media for promoting female role models
Praised for its engaging writing and inclusive cast of characters
Critically noted for fostering positive self-image and aspirations in young girls
Launched a series and expanded into multimedia formats
comparable_titles: Little Leaders: Bold Women in Black History by Vashti Harrison
Rad Women Worldwide by Kate Schatz
Women in Science: 50 Fearless Pioneers Who Changed the World by Rachel Ignotofsky
